tools.name: fal
tools.claudeConnection: Streamable HTTP, API key header or OAuth connector
tools.modelSupport: Over 1,000 models including image-to-video and text-to-video
tools.note: Documentation review 2026-09-28; product and account behaviour were not tested.

quickstart.label: Claude Code command copied from the official Run MCP page. Replace YOUR_FAL_KEY with your fal API key:
quickstart.code:
claude mcp add --transport http fal-ai \
  https://mcp.fal.ai/mcp \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_FAL_KEY"
